(ta)༄༅/ /dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin dzam+bha la yab yum gyi sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpa' bo gcig pu grub pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin dzam+bha la yab yum gyi sgrub thabs man ngag dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su swā hā/ oṃ ba su shrī ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su mu khī swā hā/ oṃ shrī ba su ma ti shrī ye swā hā/ bdag nyid dzam+bha la'i gzugs su bsgoms la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su ba su dhā ra gser gyi mdog can phyag gnyis pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar phyogs la sogs pa'i phyogs na lha mo bzhis bskor ba g.yas kyis mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon gyis 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa bsgoms na yid la re ba rdzogs par byed do// ba'i lci bas dkyil 'khor gru bzhi khru do pa'i tshad du byas la/ dus gsum du me tog dri zhim pos mchod de stong phrag bzhi bzlas pa byas na zla ba drug gis yid la re ba thams cad rdzogs par byed do// ji lta ba bzhin du rnyed pa'i me tog gi sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bzhi byas na dpal chen por 'gyur zhing*/ yi ge 'bum bzlas na dpal chen po 'grub par byed do// gu gul gyi ril bu'i sbyin sreg 'bum byas na yid la re ba yongs su rdzogs par byed do// oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi a mu ke ka n+yāṃ me de hi/ dwa pa ya swā hā/ sngags 'di chu'i nang du zhugs nas khrus byas te 'bum phrag bzhi nges par bzlas pa byas na/ mngon par 'dod pa'i bu mo thob par 'gyur ro// mtshan mo 'o ma can gyi yam shing gis grong gi ming nas smos nas sbyin sreg 'bum byas na grong rnyed par 'gyur ro// oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇi swā hā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kān t+yai swā hā/ oṃ dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ su dat+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ ār+ya yai swā hā/ oṃ su bha drā yai swā hā/ oṃ gup+tā yai swā hā/ oṃ de byai swā hā/ oṃ swa ra swa t+yai swā hā/

gser gyi byang bu'am dngul gyi byang bu'am zangs ma'i byang bu'i me tog la 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su ba su dhā ra/ shar la sogs pa'i 'dab ma la tsan+d+ra kān+t+yai la sogs pa gnod sbyin mo rnams mngon par bris pa'i byang bu gnyis kha sbyang du byas pa'i nang du mar dang sbrang rtsi dang ka ra bcug ste/ gong du bshad pa'i tshogs sngar smos pa'i las rnams byed par 'gyur ro// dbus su ni oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya swā hā/ phyogs su ni oṃ ma ṇi bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ pūṇ+ṇa bha drā ya swā hā/ oṃ dha na dā ya swā hā/ oṃ bai shra ba ṇā ya swā hā/ mtshams su ni oṃ ki li mā li ni swā hā/ oṃ tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa li ni swā hā/ oṃ mu khen+d+rā ya swā hā/ oṃ tsa ren+d+rā ya swā hā/ gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'o// bcom ldan 'das ni ba su dhā ri dang bcas pa gser gyi mdog can/ ne'u le dang bī dza pū ra sa bon gyis bkang ba phyag na bsnams pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gong du bshad pa'i gnod sbyin mo dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po dang bcas pa la/ dus gsum du mchod pa byas nas/ bsgoms shing bzlas pa byas na bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jig rten gsum gyi rgyal srid stsol bar mdzad do// tho rangs chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad sbyin pa dang*/ bya rog gi skad ma grags par chu'i nang du bzhugs te/ bzlas pa byas pa de'i gter mi zad cing 'phel bar 'gyur ro// yang na gser la sogs pa'i byang bu la ba su dhā ra gnod sbyin mo dang bcas pa dang*/ byang bu gnyis pa la bcom ldan 'das dzam+bha la gnod sbyin gyis bskor ba yang dag par bris la/ kha sbyar du byas te mnyes par byas na dngos grub chen po brgyad kyang ster bar mdzad na/ grub pa gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ zhes bya ba ni rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i le'u gnyis pa las phyung ba'o//

༈ /gsang sngags bcu bdun pa'i bdag nyid dzam+bha la'i gzugs su zhes bya ba ni/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa rgyas pa'am/ skyabs 'gro dang byang chub kyi sems dang*/ stong pa nyid bsgom pa tsam las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dzam̐ mam/ dzam̐ las byung ba'i bī dza pū ra las dzam+bha la bskyed/ de'i snying gar rang rang gi sngags sam bam̐ tsam las gtso 'khor lnga bskyed par bya ste/ dbus su nor rgyun ma/ shar du dpal nor can/ lhor nor gyi dpal mo/ nub tu dpal nor gyi gdong can/ byang du dpal nor gyi blo gros ma sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gtso mo dang mthun pa bskyed la/ sngon du bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi bya/ de nas gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin bsgrubs na las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// bcu dgu pa dang nyi shu pa'i mngon par rtogs pa ni/ sngon du 'gro ba tshogs gnyis bsags pa rgyas bsdus gang rung bya/ bh+rūm̐ las gzhal yas khang bsgom/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa la nor rgyun ma lha mo brgyad kyis bskor ba bsgom pa dang*/ dzam+bha la gnod sbyin chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba bsgom pa dang*/ yab yum gnyis su med par bsgom pa ste sgrub thabs gsum yin no// gang ltar yang bskyed pa'i cho ga ni rang rang gi sngags kyis rim pa bzhin du bskyed pa dang*/ bam̐ las 'bras kyi snye ma las gtso mo grub pa'i lha mo rnams bsgom zhing*/ dzam̐ dang bī dza pū ra las dzam+bha la bskyed pa'i dus su gnod sbyin rnams bskyed pa gang rung yin no// de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ bdag nyid la mchod bstod byas nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags 'bum phrag bzhi sngon du bsnyen pa byas la las rnams bsgrub par bya ba yin no// de lta bu'i bsnyen pa ma grub kyang rung ste/ mnyes par bya ba'i cho ga ni/ gser ram/ dngul lam/ zangs sam/ shog bu la pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gnyis bya/ gcig la gnod sbyin pho dgu/ gcig la gnod sbyin mo dgu bris pa ste/

de yang gzugs kyi snying gar sngags bri ba'am/ gzugs med na sngags rang bri bar gang rung yin no// sngags la spel tshig yod pa'am med pa gang rung bri ste/ spel tshig dang bcas pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya ma ma dhā naṃ de hi de hi swā hā/ zhes bya ba ste/ gzhan rnams la'ang de bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o// de lta bu bris la snod kyi nang du mdun du bzhag la/ pū dza dang gtor ma rgya chen po bsham/ bdag yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ lha bco brgyad so so rang rang gi gnas su bskyed/ ye shes sems dpa' bkug la bstim/ pū dza dang gtor ma rgya chen po dbul/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sha kha ra'i chus khyab par bsku/ de nas thabs shes rab gnyis su med par rjes su chags pa'i pū dza bcas par bshams la/ rang rang gi yab dang yum ma 'khrul par yi ge dang zhal rnams thad kar sbyar la/ mo'i tsakra 'og pho'i steng du 'byung zhing phyogs rnams kyang ma 'khrul bar yong bar byas la skud pa ser pos rgya gram du dkris la de'ang za ma tog chen po'i nang du bzhag la/ mar dang sbrang rtsi dang sha kha ras nub par byas te/ dus rgyun du me tog dang gtor ma la sogs pas mchod pa byas na dngos grub thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// snying gar lha lnga bsgom pa la sgrub thabs gcig dang*/ 'di la sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba gsum logs na'ang yod do// zhes rje btsun rin po che grags pa'i 'grel pa las phyung ba'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa spel ba'i slad du gnod sbyin 'khor lo sgrub pa'i tshul lag tu blang ba la gsum/ bdag bskyed bya ba/ 'khor lo bris te rab gnas bya ba/ mdun bskyed byas te 'jug pa sogs bya ba'o// bdag bskyed ni/ nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ yang na 'di pha rgyud dang mthun pas gsang 'dus rigs gsum gang rung gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob la ma nyams pa'i rnal 'byor pas gnas dben par/

mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga/ gtor ma gcig bsham/ rang gi mdun du rdo rje dril bu gzhag stan bde ba la kha byang du phyogs par 'dug ste/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba la gnas pa'i bam̐ yig gser po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang nor rgyun ma gnyis su med pa'i nor lha'i dkyil 'khor oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ thal mo sbyar nas/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang*/ na maḥshrī ba su dha ri ṇ+yai maṇ+ḍal le bh+yaḥ zhes pas nam mkhar gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor la phyag bya/ oṃ shrī dha naṃ de hi maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa so so'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha/ de bzhin du/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke/ badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ya/ badz+ra shab+da rnams kyi mjug tu/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ sbyar la mchod/ don yid la dran bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis bdun rnam dag bya/ sems can thams cad sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de nas ye shes tshogs gsog ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa'i stong pa nyid du bsams la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pa ni sngon 'gro'o// dngos gzhi la rten bskyed pa dang*/ brten pa bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ gur me ri dang bcas pa'i dbus su bh+ram̐'u las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas dkar sngo dmar ljang ser ba'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du pha gu ser po/

de'i steng du bre phul la brten pa'i gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su/ chu srin gyi kha nas drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng gi bya 'dab la mda' yab dang pu shus bskor ba nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su bris shing mdzes par phub pa/ dbus phyur bur phub pa'i steng du rdo rje dang rin po che'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol na 'dod snam la mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bskor ba/ sgo bzhi'i thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi'i steng du chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ gzhan yang gos dang*/ 'phan la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar/ lho sngo/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus ser ba'i lte bar pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re bsams pa ni rten bskyed pa'o// brten pa lha la bzhi las/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bam̐ dang 'bras kyi snye ma las bdag nyid nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du/ dzam̐ dang bī dza pū ra ka las dzam+bha la dang 'khor rnams la skad cig gis shar du zla 'od ma dang nor bu bzang po/ lhor sbyin ma dang gang ba bzang po/ nub tu rab tu sbyin ma dang nor sbyin/ byang du 'phags ma dang rnam thos sras/ shar lhor rab tu bzang mo dang rol pa'i phreng ba/ lho nub tu sbas ma dang 'jam po 'khyil pa/ nub byang du mdzes ma dang gdong gi dbang po/ byang shar du dbyangs can ma dang spyod pa'i dbang po/ thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi na bza' can/ mo rnams kyi phyag g.yas pas shing thog bī dza pū ra ka dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya can/ g.yon pa rnams kyis 'bras kyi snye ma thugs kar 'dzin pa/

bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gyings pa/ rin po che 'bar ba skyugs par gyur pa'i pad+ma'i gter la sogs pa'i steng du skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs pa'i brla g.yon pa rnams kyi steng du/ pho rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i phyag g.yas pa rnams shing thog bī dza pū ra ka 'dzin pas mo rnams kyi g.yon nas mgul par 'khyud pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis ne'u le 'dzin pa'o// nyer sgrub ni/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ sgrub pa ni/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal mo nor rgyun ma la nor lha'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ tshogs zhing ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ye shes pa bstim mo// sgrub chen ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar sogs nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ thams cad la rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas mchod pa/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du lha rdzas las byung ba'i mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs so so'i sngags rgyas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ gis spel la mtshan sngags re re sbyar bas mchod/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇis rol mo dbul/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung bcom ldan ma// dpal dang 'byor pa'i dbang phyug nor rgyun ma// yid la re ba'i bkra shis stsol mdzad ma// bsam 'phel dkyil 'khor dbang phyug ma la 'dud// ces pas bstod/

de nas bzlas pa ni/ rang nor rgyun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ ser po'i mthar/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇ+yai swā hās g.yas su bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas rang gi snying gar thim pas dpal dang 'byor pa'i dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ ba su dhā ri ṇ+yai swā hā/ zhes pa 'bum phrag bcu bzlas la/ thun mtshams rnams su 'khor rnams la/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kān+t+yai swā hā/ dat+tā yai/ su dat+tā yai/ ār+ya yai/ su bha drā yai/ gup+tā yai/ de byai/ sa ra swa t+yai/ zhes pas yum rnams dang*/ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya/ ma ṇi bha drā ya/ pūr+ṇa bha drā ya/ dha na dā ya/ bai shra wa ṇā ya/ ke li mā li ni/ tsi pi kuṇ+ḍa le ni/ mu khen+dā ya/ oṃ tsa ren+d+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pa khri phrag bcu re bzla zhing thun bzhir byas la/ thun rjes su thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ snod bcud thams cad srung ba'i 'khor lo la/ de gzhal yas khang la/ de 'khor rnams la/ de gtso bo yab yum la/ yab kyang yum la bsdus la smon lam gdab/ thun mtshams rnams su gtor ma gtang na/ gtor ma chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal mo nor rgyun ma'i dkyil 'khor la nor lha'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ rdo rje thal mo kha phye bas gong gi sngags phreng gi mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tshan+tu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa lan gsum la sogs pas phul la/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gnas gsum bsrungs la badz+ra muḥs gtor mgron rang gnas su gshegs par bsams la smon lam gang shes bya'o// 'khor lo bris te rab gnas bya ba ni/

skar ma rgyal la bab dus/ bri gzhi gser dngul zangs sam gang rung la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su lha'i sku'am/ sngags bris pa'am/ ma 'byor na shog bu la gser shog sbyar ba'am/ gur gum dang gi wang sogs byugs pa la/ gser gyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshad mnyam pa gnyis bris pa'i mo 'khor 'og dang*/ pho 'khor steng du 'ong bar bya'o// 'khor lo'i dpe ris 'og tu bris pa bzhin nor 'khrul med pas 'di ltar bris shig de nas 'khor lo zangs gzhong sogs snod gtsang ma'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs bkram pa'i dbus su 'khor lo gnyis phyi nas rang la zhal phyogs par bshams pa'i mdun du mchod yon sngon 'gro'i mchod pa bsham/ sbyong chas mtheb kyu/ ting lo/ zan chang*/ gu gul/ yungs kar/ 'thor nas rnams sta gon bya/ rdo rje dril bu'ang bshams la/ rnal 'byor pa zhal byang du phyogs pas gong bzhin bdag bskyed/ bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya/ mtheb kyu chab kyis bran/ ting lo sbar la/ mtheb kyus 'khor lo la bskor zhing*/ sarba bigh+nān sogs gsum/ ting lo dang zan chang gis sum+bha sogs gsum brjod la/ 'dir gnod sbyin 'khor lo sgrub pa la bar chad byed pa'i gdon bgegs gang yin pa thams cad 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces dang*/ khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgya dang*/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang sogs kyis bden pa brdar/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ 'dir gnod sbyin 'khor lo la rab tu gnas par byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad la rgyud sde dang mthun pa'i sbyong ba byas zin pas 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig gal te mi 'gro na ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i rdo rjes mgo bo tshal par 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ sum+bha sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ gis bgegs drag pos sbyang*/

ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis khrus byas par bsams la/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis 'khor lo mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ rma byas bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdang pad+ma las 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ dar gyi stod g.yogs dang sham thabs can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'og min dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas mchod pa rnams oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas sbyang*/ byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ a mī ta bhā wa hrīḥs pa ri wā ra so sor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ gaṇ+ḍe ra ṇis rol mo dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi sku// kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// ting 'dzin chen po'i phyag rgya can// phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la// zhes pas bstod/ 'od dpag med zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lo'i yig 'brur gyur par bsams la/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re dang*/ ye dharmā brgya rtsa re bzlas pas brtan par bya/ me tog dor zhing*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ yang yang brjod/ sbyin bdag gi 'byor pa rgyas pa'i 'dod don gsol lo// de nas 'khor lo gnyis la gser sogs rin po che sna tshogs kyi phye ma/ gur gum sogs dri zhim po rnams mar dang*/

sbrang rtsi dang*/ ka ra la sbyar zhing byugs la kha sbyar/ pho 'khor steng dang mo 'khor 'og tu zhal sbyor yod par bya/ dar ram ras skud ser pos nub par dkris/ skud pa'i lhag ma pho 'khor gyi steng du mdud pa'i khug so byas la steng 'og mi nor ba'i rtags bya'o// mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni/ gnas dben par phyag dar bya/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa dar ram ras ser pos bkab pa'i steng du zangs gzhong la sogs par 'bru sna dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs/ gos dar sna tshogs/ zas sna tshogs tshad/ sman sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa'i dbus su/ dar ser po'i steng du 'khor lo zhal lhor phyogs par bshams pa'i steng du dar ser po'i gur phub/ 'khor lo'i steng gi skud pa'i khug so la gzungs thag ser po gdags/ mchod yon sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga bsham/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma gcig bsham/ sgrub pa po grangs du yod kyi mdun du rdor dril me tog ser po rnams gzhag bsnyen song gi sgrub pa po zhal 'khor lo la phyogs par 'dug bdag bskyed bzlas pa/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar gong bzhin bya/ 'khor lo bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ srung 'khor nas brtsams te yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bdag bskyed ltar rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar gong bzhin byas rjes gzungs thag nas bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng ser po gzungs thag la brten te song*/ 'khor lo'i lha'i thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sbyin bdag gis gtso byas sems can thams cad la phog pas/ tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad rgyas par bsam/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ 'khor lo yon bdag dang bcas pa la thim par bsams la/ 'khor lo la bkod pa'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla/

thun 'jog dus/ bcom ldan 'das mas sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtsor byas sems can thams cad kyi zas nor longs spyod rgyas par mdzad du gsol lo// zhes brjod la me tog gtor/ gong ltar mchod bstod bya'o// gtor ma byin rlabs bdag bskyed kyi skabs bzhin dbul/ lha zhu ba las byung ba'i 'khor lor bsam/ rnal 'byor pa mang po yod na/ gsung mi chag gi tshul du bya ste/ thun len ran na thun len pas bdag bskyed dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i bar bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung*/ mdun bskyed gong bzhin bya/ thun len la gtang la/ rang gis mchod bstod gtor ma phul nas/ lha 'od du zhu ba sogs kun gyis shes par byas la/ sbyin bdag dang rnal 'byor pa la rmi ltas bzang po ma byung gi bar la bsgrub/ grub nas rten gyi zhabs dang gzhan yang bang mdzod du bkur sti dang bcas te bzhag la/ gsang zhing zas nor gang byung gi phud phul na longs spyod 'phel nges so// gong ltar 'khor lo'i steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams su 'bru sna/ sman sna/ dar sna/ rin po che'i rigs gang 'byor dar ser pos dril la gzhug go /'di rje bla ma'i gsung dang phyag len 'khrul med yin pas 'di kho na ltar bya'o// zhes rje btsun e wam̐ chen po dkon mchog dpal ldan pas mdzad pa'i rab gnas kyi cho ga dpal 'byor rgya mtsho las khol du phyung ba'o// sarba dā shrī bhū ti maṅga la bar+dhan+tu// //'di ni deng sang phyag len yongs grags kyi 'khor lo 'bring po yin la/ rgyas par so so'i sku gzugs bris pa'i thugs kar 'khor lo 'di ltar bri ba dang*/ bsdus par dzaṃ dgu lam̐ dgu tsam bris pas chog par stag tshang lo tsā ba'i rten gsum bzhengs thabs dpal 'byor rgya mtsho sogs las gsungs so// //maṅga laṃ// // dogs pa
